Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.staticfile

Class WebJarResolver

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.staticfile.WebJarResolver
public final class WebJarResolver extends Object
Resolves a WebJar file to a cache-busted URL under the WebJarsMixin mount.

An asset is named groupId:artifactId:path (see asset(String, String, String)). The path is relative to META-INF/resources/webjars/ and may contain VERSION_TOKEN, which is replaced with the version read from the WebJar's own META-INF/maven/<groupId>/<artifactId>/pom.properties. The URL gets a ?v=<version> cache-buster, so a version bump in the app's pom changes every URL.

A missing WebJar, or a missing file in a present WebJar, throws IllegalStateException, so a page never renders a tag that would 404. Versions and file checks are cached for the life of the class loader.

Example:

String asset = WebJarResolver.asset("org.webjars", "jquery", "jquery/{version}/jquery.min.js"); String url = WebJarResolver.resolve(req, asset); // .../webjars/jquery/3.7.1/jquery.min.js?v=3.7.1

Since:
10.0.0
